Governments wade in karne lagi hain. Congress mein ek bill aaya — Algorithmic Accountability Act — jo companies ko apne AI systems audit karne ke liye mandate karega (badi companies — revenues $50 million se zyada aur 1 million+ users). Enforce karega Federal Trade Commission.

States aur cities bhi: 2019 mein New York City ne AI mein zyada transparency ka law pass kiya. Washington state, Illinois aur Massachusetts mein bhi efforts hain.

Kuch companies proactive ho rahi hain — apne ethics boards bana rahi hain. Microsoft ka ethics board Aether (AI and Ethics in Engineering and Research) ne California mein traffic stops ke liye facial recognition use karne se mana kar diya.

AI activism bhi ho sakta hai — log certain applications ke khilaf protest karenge. Amazon ka Rekognition software (facial recognition se law enforcement ko suspects identify karne mein madad) iska target bana. ACLU ne accuracy par concerns uthaye — khaas taur par women aur minorities ke liye. Ek experiment mein Rekognition ne Congress ke 28 members ko prior criminal records wala identify kar diya! Amazon ne claims ko dispute kiya.

Doosra controversial example: COMPAS (Correctional Offender Management Profiling for Alternative Sanctions) — analytics se probability gauge karta hai ki koi crime karega ya nahi. Sentencing mein use hota hai. Issue: kya yeh due process ke constitutional right ko violate karta hai — AI galat ya discriminatory ho sakta hai? Abhi few good answers hain. Lekin justice system mein AI algorithms ki importance ko dekhte hue, Supreme Court naye law banayega — yeh likely hai.

SourceApress — Artificial Intelligence Basics: A Non-Technical Introduction (2019), Chapter 9
← PreviousDrug Discovery — AI se nayi dawaaiyanNext →AGI — Artificial General Intelligence
9.11Chapter 9 — The Future of AI

AGI — Artificial General Intelligence

Chapter 1 mein humne Weak AI aur Strong AI ka farak seekha. Aaj hum Weak AI phase mein hain — narrow categories ke liye technology.

Strong AI ka ultimate matlab hai — machine insaan ko rival kar sake. Ise Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) kehte hain. Yeh hasil karna shayad kai saal door hai — agle century tak ya kabhi nahi bhi.

Lekin kuch brilliant researchers ko lagta hai AGI jald aayegi. Ek inventor, futurist, bestselling author aur Google ke director of Engineering ne kaha ki AGI hogi — Turing Test 2019 mein crack hoga, aur 2045 tak Singularity aayegi — jahan hybrid log honge: part human, part machine.

Crazy lagta hai? Shayad. Lekin unke kai high-profile followers hain.

AGI ke liye bahut mehnat chahiye. Deep learning mein bhi bahut data aur computing power chahiye. AGI ko naye approaches chahiye honge:

  • Unsupervised learning ki ability
  • Transfer learning — jaise Go khelne wala system woh knowledge doosre games ya fields mein use kar sake
  • Common sense, abstraction, curiosity aur causal relationships (sirf correlations nahi) samajhne ki capacity

Hardware aur chip technologies mein breakthroughs chahiye honge — yeh ek top AI researcher (Facebook ke chief AI scientist) ki rai hai. Batteries aur energy sources mein bhi progress chahiye.

Ek aur critical cheez: AI field mein diversity. AI Now Institute ki report ke hisaab se lagbhag 80% AI professors men hain; Facebook aur Google ke AI research staffs mein women 15% aur 10% respectively hain. Yeh lopsidedness research ko bias ke liye susceptible banati hai, aur broader views ka fayda kho jata hai.

SourceApress — Artificial Intelligence Basics: A Non-Technical Introduction (2019), Chapter 9
← PreviousGovernment aur regulation — Alexa, Rekognition, COMPASNext →AI for Social Good — McKinsey ke 160 use cases
9.12Chapter 9 — The Future of AI

AI for Social Good — McKinsey ke 160 use cases

Ek management consulting firm ne "Applying Artificial Intelligence for Social Good" naam ki extensive study likhi — AI kaise poverty, natural disasters aur education improve karne mein use ho rahi hai. Study mein lagbhag 160 use cases hain. Kuch dekhte hain:

  • Social media platforms ka analysis disease outbreaks track karne mein madad karta hai.
  • Ek nonprofit, Rainforest Connection, TensorFlow se AI models banata hai — audio data se illegal logging locate karne ke liye.
  • Researchers ne neural network banaya jo Africa mein poachers ke videos par train hota hai. Drone thermal infrared images se violators detect karne ke liye areas par udta hai.
  • AI Flint city ke 55,893 parcels ka data analyse karke lead poisoning ka evidence dhoondhti hai. System Bayesian model par based hai — toxicity ki sophisticated predictions. Health workers jaldi action le sakte hain — potentially lives bach sakti hain.

Conclusion: Yeh topic kitab khatm karne ke liye achhi jagah hai. Potential harm aur adverse consequences ke bawajood, AI mein duniya ko transform karne ki sachhi promise hai. Aur achhi khabar hai ki kai log isse reality banane par focus kar rahe hain. Yeh bade paise kamane ya fame pane ke baare mein nahi hai — goal duniya ko badalna hai.

Chapter 9 ke Key Takeaways: Autonomous cars nayi nahi hain, lekin inflection point 2004 mein DARPA contest se aaya. Key components: video cameras, Lidar, sensors. Autonomy ke 5 levels hain — 5th fully autonomous hai. Challenges: infrastructure, regulation, costs, consumer adoption. US AI mein global leader mana jata hai, lekin China heavily invest kar raha hai — data aur skilled engineers uske fayde hain. AI se mass unemployment ka darr hai — blue-collar ya white-collar dono. Technology ne industries ko affect kiya hai, lekin markets adaptable rahe hain. Drones ne warfare badla hai — AI se machines battlefield par faisle le sakti hain. Near term mein AI ka zyada impact false information failane par hoga. AI drug discovery mein bahut madad karegi — Gilead jaise bade pharma explore kar rahe hain. Privacy aur transparency ki chinta badhegi — regulations aayenge. AGI woh hai jahan system mein human intelligence ho — abhi door hai, unsupervised learning aur naye hardware ki zaroorat hogi.

SourceApress — Artificial Intelligence Basics: A Non-Technical Introduction (2019), Chapter 9

Glossary — A se M

Kitab ke Glossary ke terms A se M tak — har term ki definition kitab ke hisaab se.

TermMatlab
Activation FunctionDeep learning models mein non-linear relationships calculate karne mein madad karti hai.
ActuatorsElectro-mechanical devices jaise motors — robot ke movement mein madad karte hain.
AIArtificial Intelligence dekho.
AI WinterLamba period (jaise 1970s aur 1980s) jab AI industry par pressure tha — funding cuts jaise.
Artificial IntelligenceComputers experience se seekh sakte hain — sophisticated algorithms se data process karke. Broad category hai — ML, DL aur NLP iske subsets hain.
Artificial Neural Network (ANN)Deep learning model ki sabse basic structure — multiple hidden layers jo sophisticated algorithms se data process karti hain.
Automation FatigueRPA mein — jaise-jaise zyada tasks automate hote hain, improvement kam hota jata hai.
Automated Machine Learning (AutoML)Digital tool ya platform jo beginners ko apne AI models banane deta hai.
BackpropagationDeep learning mein badi breakthrough — models mein weightings assign karne mein zyada efficient.
Bayes' TheoremStatistical measure jo ML mein probabilities ko zyada accurate banata hai.
Big DataHuge amounts of data process karne wali technology — 3 Vs: volume, variety, velocity.
BinningData ko groups mein organize karna.
Categorical DataData jiska numerical meaning nahi, textual meaning hai — jaise race ya gender describe karna.
Cerebral CortexHuman brain ka woh part jo AI se sabse zyada similar hai — thinking aur cognitive activities mein madad karta hai.
ChatbotAI system jo logon se communicate karta hai.
ClusteringUnsupervised learning ka form — unlabeled data ko algorithms se similar items ke groups mein daalna.
CobotRobot jo logon ke saath kaam karta hai.
Cognitive Robotic Process Automation (CRPA)RPA system jo AI technologies leverage karta hai.
Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)Deep learning model jo data par alag variations (convolutions) se analysis karta hai. Facial recognition jaise complex applications mein use hota hai.
Data LakeMassive amounts of structured aur unstructured data store aur process karne deta hai — data ko re-format karne ki zyada zaroorat nahi.
Data TypeVariable kis type ki information represent karti hai — Boolean, integer, string ya floating point number.
Decision TreeML algorithm jo decision paths ka workflow hota hai.
DeepfakeDeep learning models se misleading ya harmful images ya videos banana.
Deep LearningAI ka type jo neural networks use karta hai — dimaag ke processes ko mimic karta hai. Pichle decade ki zyada innovation DL research mein hui hai.
Ensemble ModellingPredictions generate karne ke liye ek se zyada models use karna.
ETL (Extraction, Transformation, and Load)Data integration ka form — typically data warehouse mein use hota hai.
Ethics BoardCommittee jo AI projects ke issues evaluate karti hai.
Expert SystemEarly AI application (1980s) — sophisticated logic systems se medicine, finance aur manufacturing jaise areas samajhne mein madad karti thi.
ExplainabilityDeep learning model ke underlying causes ko samajhne ka process.
False PositiveJab model prediction bataye ki result true hai, jabki woh nahi hai.
FeatureData ka ek column.
Feature EngineeringFeature Extraction dekho.
Feature ExtractionAI model ke liye variables select karne ka process.
Feed-Forward Neural NetworkDeep learning model jo hidden layers se linear direction mein data process karta hai — peeche cycle nahi hota.
Generative Adversarial Network (GAN)Next-generation deep learning model jo naye outputs banane mein madad karta hai — audio, text ya video. Ek AI researcher ne develop kiya tha.
GPUs (Graphics Processing Units)Chips jo pehle high-speed video games ke liye bane the — badi matra mein data jaldi process kar sakte hain. AI applications mein bhi adept hain.
HadoopBig Data manage karne deta hai — sophisticated data warehouses banana possible banata hai.
Hidden LayersDeep learning model mein analysis ke alag-alag levels.
Hidden Markov Model (HMM)Algorithm jo spoken words decipher karne mein use hota hai.
HyperparametersModel ki woh features jo training process se directly seekhi nahi ja sakti.
InstanceData ki ek row.
Jupyter NotebookWeb-based app jo Python aur R mein code likhna, visualizations banana aur AI systems import karna aasan banata hai.
K-Means ClusteringAlgorithm jo similar unlabeled data ko group karne mein effective hai.
K-Nearest Neighbor (k-NN)ML algorithm jo similarities ke basis par data classify karta hai.
LemmatizationNLP mein process jo affixes/prefixes hatakar similar root words dhoondhta hai.
Lidar (Light Detection and Ranging)Device (aam taur par autonomous car ke upar) jo laser beams se surroundings measure karta hai.
Linear RegressionCertain variables ke beech relationship dikhata hai — ML systems mein predictions mein madad karta hai.
Machine LearningComputer data process karke seekh aur improve kar sakta hai — bina explicitly programmed hue. AI ka subset hai.
MetadataData ke baare mein data — descriptions. Example: music file ka size, length, upload date, comments, genre, artist.
SourceApress — Artificial Intelligence Basics: A Non-Technical Introduction (2019), End Matter

A.3End Matter

Glossary — N se Z

Kitab ke Glossary ke terms N se Z tak — har term ki definition kitab ke hisaab se.

TermMatlab
Naïve Bayes ClassifierML ka method jo Bayes' theorem se predictions karta hai — variables ek doosre se independent hote hain.
Named Entity RecognitionNLP process mein — locations, persons aur organizations ko represent karne wale words identify karna.
Natural Language Processing (NLP)AI ka subset jo computers ke language samajhne aur manipulate karne se deal karta hai.
Neural NetworkSophisticated AI model jo dimaag ko mimic karta hai — multiple layers jo unique patterns dhoondhne ki koshish karti hain.
Normal DistributionData ka plot jo bell jaisa dikhta hai — midpoint mean hota hai.
NoSQL SystemNext-generation database — document model par based, analysis mein flexibility deta hai aur structured + unstructured data handle karta hai.
Ordinal DataNumerical aur categorical data ka mix — jaise product ki rating.
OverfittingJab model accurate nahi hota kyunki data tested cheez ko reflect nahi karta ya galat features par focus hota hai.
Pearson CorrelationCorrelation ki strength dikhata hai — 1 se -1 tak. 1 ke kareeb ho to correlation zyada accurate hai.
PhonemesLanguage ki sabse basic sound units.
Predictive AnalyticsData use karke forecasts banana.
PythonComputer language jo AI models develop karne mein standard ban gayi hai.
PyTorchPlatform jo sophisticated AI models banane deta hai.
Recurrent Neural Network (RNN)Deep learning model jo prior inputs ko time ke saath process karta hai. Common use case: messaging app mein type karte waqt agla word predict karna.
Reinforcement LearningAI model banane ka approach — system ko sahi predictions par reward aur galat par punishment milti hai.
Relational DatabaseDatabase (roots 1970s mein) jo tables ke beech relationships banata hai aur SQL naam ki scripting language rakhta hai.
Robotic Desktop Automation (RDA)RPA system jo employee ke saath kaam karta hai.
Robotic Process Automation (RPA)Software ki category jo organization mein routine aur mundane tasks automate karti hai. Aksar AI implement karne ka pehla tareeka hota hai.
Robot Operating System (ROS)Open source middleware system jo robot ke critical parts manage karta hai.
R-squaredRegression ki accuracy gauge karne ka tareeka — 0 se 1 tak. 1 ke kareeb ho to accuracy zyada.
Sentiment AnalysisSocial media data mine karke trends dhoondhna.
SensorTypical sensor camera ya Lidar hota hai — laser scanner se 3D images banata hai.
SigmoidDeep learning model ka common activation function — value 0 se 1 tak hoti hai. 1 ke kareeb ho to accuracy zyada.
Standard DeviationMean se average distance measure karta hai — data mein variation ka sense deta hai.
StemmingWord ko uske root (lemma) tak reduce karne ka process — affixes/suffixes hatakar.
Strong AITrue AI — machine human-like abilities mein engage kar sakti hai, jaise open-ended discussions.
Structured DataData jo aam taur par relational database ya spreadsheet mein store hota hai — preformatted structure mein (jaise Social Security numbers, addresses, point of sale information).
Tagging Parts of Speech (POS)NLP process mein — text ko dekh kar har word ko uska proper grammatical form dena (nouns, verbs, adverbs).
TensorFlowOpen source platform jo sophisticated AI models banane deta hai.
Test DataData jis se model ki accuracy evaluate ki jati hai.
Three Laws of RoboticsScience-fiction writings par based — basic framework jisse robots ko society ke saath interact karna chahiye.
TokenizationNLP process jismein text parse aur segment kiya jata hai.
Topic ModellingNLP process mein — text mein hidden patterns aur clusters dhoondhna.
Training DataData jo AI algorithm banane ke liye use hota hai.
True PositiveJab model sahi prediction karta hai.
Turing TestEk tareeka jisse determine kiya jata hai ki system ne true AI achieve kiya ya nahi. Test mein ek vyakti 2 participants se sawaal poochta hai — ek human, ek computer. Agar pata na chale ki human kaun hai, to Turing Test pass ho gaya.
Unattended Robotic Process Automation (RPA)RPA system jo completely autonomous hota hai — bot background mein chalta hai.
Unstructured DataData jiska predefined formatting nahi hai — jaise images, videos aur audio files.
Supervised LearningAI model jo labeled data use karta hai — sabse common approach.
Unsupervised LearningAI model jo unlabeled data use karta hai — patterns detect karne ke liye deep learning systems chahiye hote hain.
Vanishing Gradient ProblemBatata hai ki deep learning model bada hone par accuracy kaise decay hoti hai.
Virtual AssistantAI device jo vyakti ki daily activities mein madad karta hai.
Weak AIAI ka use ek khaas use case ke liye — jaise voice assistant.
SourceApress — Artificial Intelligence Basics: A Non-Technical Introduction (2019), End Matter

Interview FAQs

36 interview FAQs — current-era interviews ke liye, kitab ke concepts par based.

01AI, Machine Learning aur Deep Learning mein kya farak hai?
AI sabse bada umbrella hai — computer ko intelligent banane ki koshish. Machine Learning AI ka hissa hai — computer data se seekhta hai bina har rule likhe. Deep Learning ML ka hissa hai — kai layers wale neural networks use karta hai. Yaad rakhne ka tareeka: AI ke andar ML, ML ke andar DL. Interview mein example do: spam filter ML hai, image recognition DL hai, aur chatbot poori AI application hai.
02Weak AI aur Strong AI mein kya farak hai?
Weak AI (Narrow AI) ek khaas kaam mein mahir hoti hai — jaise Siri sawaal ka jawab de, ya chess khelna. Strong AI (AGI) insaan ki tarah har kaam kar sake — open-ended baat-cheet, naye kaam khud seekhna. Aaj ki saari AI Weak AI hai; Strong AI abhi bani nahi hai. Interview mein yeh bhi batao ki 2026 mein LLMs bhi Weak AI hain — woh bahut capable hain, lekin unmein consciousness aur asli samajh nahi hai.
03Turing Test kya hai aur kya koi machine ise pass kar payi hai?
Turing Test 1950 mein diya gaya tha: judge ek insaan aur ek computer se baat karta hai — agar judge pehchan na sake ki kaun machine hai, to test pass. 2014 mein ek program ne 13 saal ke ladke ka role play karke pass karne ka daava kiya, lekin experts ne is par sawaal uthaye. 2018 mein ek voice assistant ne hairdresser ko call karke appointment book ki — lekin baat-cheet scripted thi. Aaj tak koi system poori tarah se Turing Test pass nahi kar paya hai. Interview tip: test ki limitations bhi batao — sirf baat-cheet se intelligence measure nahi hoti.
04Supervised, Unsupervised aur Reinforcement Learning mein kya farak hai?
Supervised mein labelled data hota hai — har example ke saath sahi jawab likha hota hai, jaise dog-breed photos. Unsupervised mein koi label nahi — machine khud patterns dhoondhti hai, jaise customer segmentation. Reinforcement mein machine trial-and-error se seekhti hai — sahi kaam par reward, galat par punishment, jaise game khelna. Semi-supervised beech ka rasta hai — thoda labelled + bahut unlabeled data. Interview mein har ek ka ek example aur ek algorithm zaroor batao.
05Overfitting kya hai aur isse kaise roka jata hai?
Overfitting tab hota hai jab model training data ko bahut zyada yaad kar leta hai — naye data par kharab perform karta hai. Jaise student ne sirf sample paper rat liya, exam mein naye sawaal aaye to fail. Rokne ke tareeke: zyada data use karo, train/test split karo (70/30), cross-validation karo, regularization use karo, aur model ko simple rakho. Backpropagation wale figure mein dikhaya gaya hai — ek point ke baad zyada training se error badhne lagti hai.
06Bias-Variance Tradeoff kya hai?
Bias ka matlab hai model bahut simple hai — data ke patterns ko pakad nahi pata (underfitting). Variance ka matlab hai model bahut complex hai — training data ke noise ko bhi seekh leta hai (overfitting). Dono ke beech balance chahiye — na bahut simple, na bahut complex. Interview mein example do: linear regression high bias, deep neural network high variance ho sakta hai. Regularization aur cross-validation se balance milta hai.
07Bayes' Theorem ML mein kyun important hai?
Bayes' Theorem nayi jaankari milne par probability update karta hai. Classic example: cancer test 80% accurate hai, lekin bimari sirf 1% logon mein hai — positive result ke baad bhi bimari ki probability sirf 7.8% hoti hai, kyunki base rate bahut kam hai. ML mein yeh Naïve Bayes classifier ki neev hai — spam detection, medical diagnosis aur sentiment analysis mein use hota hai. Interview mein base rate neglect ki galti zaroor mention karo.
08Precision, Recall aur F1 Score kya hain?
Precision = kitne predicted positive sach mein positive the (TP / (TP+FP)). Recall = kitne actual positive pakde gaye (TP / (TP+FN)). Accuracy kabhi-kabhi dhokha deti hai — jaise fraud sirf 1% ho to sabko 'not fraud' kehne par bhi 99% accuracy mil jayegi. Isi liye imbalanced data mein precision-recall dekhte hain. F1 Score dono ka harmonic mean hai. Interview mein batao: cancer detection mein recall important hai (koi case miss na ho), spam mein precision important hai (sahi mail spam na bane).
09CNN kya hai aur yeh images ke liye kyun best hai?
CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) images ke liye banaya gaya hai. Fully connected network mein har pixel ek unit ban jata hai — parameters bahut zyada ho jate hain aur overfitting hota hai. CNN mein convolutional filter (jaise 5x5) image par ghum kar features nikalta hai, phir pooling se size chhota hota hai. Inspiration dimaag ke visual cortex se hai — pehle lines/angles, phir shapes, phir objects. CNN ke 3 layers: Convolutional, Pooling, Fully Connected. 2012 mein AlexNet ne ImageNet contest 10.8% margin se jeeta tha.
10RNN aur LSTM mein kya farak hai? Transformer kya hai?
RNN sequence data (text, speech) ke liye hai — pehle wale inputs ko yaad rakhta hai. Lekin lambe sequence mein pehli jaankari kho jati hai — isse vanishing gradient problem kehte hain. LSTM (1997) RNN ka behtar version hai — long-term memory rakhta hai. Transformer (2017) isse bhi aage hai — poora sentence ek saath parallel process karta hai, attention mechanism se. Aaj ke LLMs (jaise GPT) Transformer par based hain. Interview mein yeh evolution zaroor batao: RNN → LSTM → Transformer.
11GAN kya hai? Deepfake kaise banta hai?
GAN (Generative Adversarial Network) mein do networks ladte hain — Generator nakli cheez banata hai (photo, video), Discriminator pehchanta hai ki asli hai ya nakli. Dono baar-baar improve hote hain — aakhir mein Generator itni achhi nakal banata hai ki Discriminator bhi dhokha kha jata hai. 2014 mein banaya gaya tha. Deepfake isi ka misuse hai — kisi ka chehra doosre ke video par laga dena, ya nakli fingerprints banana. Positive use: art generation, data augmentation. Interview mein Generator-Discriminator game ko simple bhasha mein samjhao.
12Tokenization, Stemming aur Lemmatization mein kya farak hai?
Tokenization text ko chhote parts (tokens) mein todta hai — 'John ate four cupcakes' ke 4 tokens. Stemming word ko root tak le jata hai affixes hata kar — 'running' → 'run' — lekin kabhi-kabhi galat root deta hai (Porter stemmer 'universal' aur 'university' ko ek mana). Lemmatization similar root words dhoondhta hai matlab samajh kar — 'better' → 'good'. Lemmatization behtar hai lekin slow aur heavy hai; stemming fast lekin rough hai. Interview mein trade-off batao.
13NLP pipeline ke main steps kya hain?
Step 1 — Cleaning aur Preprocessing: tokenization, normalization (case, punctuation), stop words hatana, stemming/lemmatization. Step 2 — Understanding aur Generation: POS tagging (noun/verb pehchanna), chunking (phrases banana), Named Entity Recognition (locations, persons, organizations), Topic Modelling (LDA se hidden patterns). Aage deep learning models (CNN/RNN/Transformer) se translation, sentiment analysis aur Q&A hota hai. Voice ke liye HMM se lekar LSTM tak ka safar hai — Audrey (1952) se Siri tak.
14Word Embeddings kya hain? TF-IDF kya hai?
Word Embeddings words ko numbers (vectors) mein badalte hain — jin words ka matlab similar ho, unke vectors paas hote hain. Jaise 'king' - 'man' + 'woman' ≈ 'queen'. TF-IDF ek purana tareeka hai — Term Frequency × Inverse Document Frequency: jo word ek document mein zyada aur baaki documents mein kam aaye, woh important hai. Embeddings context samajhte hain, TF-IDF sirf frequency ginta hai. Interview mein batao: modern NLP mein embeddings (Word2Vec, BERT) use hote hain.
15LLM kya hai aur yeh GPT-2 se kaise aage badha?
LLM (Large Language Model) bahut bade text data par train hua Transformer model hai — agla word predict karke text generate karta hai. GPT-2 (2019) 8 million web pages par train hua tha — unicorn wali kahani likh kar dikhaya tha, aur reading comprehension tests mein purane records tode the. Uske baad models bade hote gaye — GPT-3, GPT-4 — aur aaj ke LLMs coding, reasoning aur tool use karte hain. Interview mein batao: LLM 'samajhta' nahi hai — woh patterns se agla word predict karta hai; isiliye kabhi-kabhi galat lekin confident jawab deta hai (hallucination).
16RAG kya hai aur LLM ke saath kyun use hota hai?
RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) mein LLM ko jawab dene se pehle relevant documents retrieve karke diye jate hain — jaise khuli kitab se exam dena. Isse hallucination kam hoti hai aur fresh/private data use ho sakta hai bina model ko dobara train kiye. Steps: documents ko chunks mein todo, embeddings banao, vector database mein store karo, query se similar chunks dhoondho, LLM ko context ke saath bhejo. Interview mein batao: RAG vs fine-tuning — RAG knowledge ke liye, fine-tuning behaviour/style ke liye.
17AI Winter kya tha aur kyun aaya?
AI Winter woh daur tha jab AI par funding aur interest khatm ho gaya — pehla 1970s mein, doosra 1990s ke aas-paas. Kaaran: computers kamzor the (128K memory), over-optimistic predictions galat nikli ('20 saal mein machine insaan jitni smart'), Lighthill Report (1973) ne kaha AI ka koi major impact nahi hoga, aur DARPA ne funding kat di. Researchers ne apne kaam ko 'machine learning' kehna shuru kar diya taaki funding milti rahe. Interview mein lesson batao: hype se bacho — realistic timelines aur measurable results do.
18Expert Systems kyun fail hue?
Expert Systems If-Then rules par based the — human expert ke rules computer mein daal do. XCON ne $40M bachaye, Deep Blue ne chess jeeta. Lekin fail hue kyunki: bahut narrow the, maintain karna mushkil tha (har naya rule likhna padta tha), experts aapas mein disagree karte the, aur yeh seekhte nahi the — naya data aaye to bhi purane rules. Machine Learning ne isiliye jeeta — rules likhne ki jagah data se seekhna. Interview mein batao: aaj ke rule-based systems (jaise kuch chatbots) wahi purani problem face karte hain.
19Backpropagation kya hai? Gradient Descent kaise kaam karta hai?
Backpropagation mein network ki galti (error) ko peeche bhej kar har weight ko thoda adjust kiya jata hai — baar-baar, jab tak error kam na ho jaye. Gradient Descent woh optimization hai jo batata hai ki weights ko kis direction mein aur kitna badalna hai — jaise pahad se neeche utarna, sabse steep rasta dhoondh kar. Learning rate batata hai ki har step kitna bada ho. 1986 ke paper ne isse mashhoor kiya. Interview mein batao: learning rate zyada ho to minimum se aage nikal jayega, kam ho to training bahut slow hogi.
20Activation Function kya hai? Sigmoid, ReLU mein kya farak hai?
Activation Function neuron ke output ko non-linear banati hai — bina iske network sirf seedhi line seekh payega. Sigmoid value ko 0–1 mein compress karta hai (S-shape) — purana tareeka, lekin deep networks mein vanishing gradient problem deta hai. ReLU (Rectified Linear Unit) aaj standard hai — negative ko 0, positive ko waisa ka waisa. Fast hai aur vanishing gradient kam karta hai. Interview mein batao: output layer mein problem ke hisaab se function chunte hain — binary ke liye sigmoid, multi-class ke liye softmax.
21K-Means Clustering kaise kaam karta hai? Optimal k kaise chunein?
K-Means mein pehle k chuno, phir k random centroids rakho. Har point ko sabse kareebi centroid se jodo, phir centroid ko group ka midpoint banao. Baar-baar dohrayo jab tak centroids hilna band na kar dein — isse convergence kehte hain. Optimal k ke liye elbow method use karo — alag-alag k par error plot karo, jahan curve mude (elbow), wahi best k hai. Limitations: non-spherical data aur thin-data clusters par fail hota hai. Interview mein batao: k-means ko pehle data ko visualize karke, phir elbow method se k chunna chahiye.
22Decision Tree aur Random Forest mein kya farak hai?
Decision Tree ek flowchart hai — root node se sawaal poochte hue leaf tak pahuncho (Titanic example: sex, age, sibsp). Pros: samajhna aasan, transparent. Cons: ek galat split poora tree bigaad deta hai, overfitting hota hai. Random Forest kai decision trees ka ensemble hai — har tree alag random data par train hota hai, aakhir mein majority vote se faisla hota hai. Overfitting kam hota hai, accuracy zyada hoti hai — lekin transparency kam ho jati hai. Interview mein batao: yeh bagging ka example hai.
23Linear Regression aur Logistic Regression mein kya farak hai?
Linear Regression continuous value predict karta hai — jaise ghar ki keemat (Grade = hours × 0.03731 + 0.6889, R-squared 0.9180). Logistic Regression classification karta hai — jaise spam ya not-spam — sigmoid function se probability 0–1 mein nikalta hai. Naam mein 'regression' hai lekin kaam classification ka hai. Interview mein batao: linear mein output number hota hai, logistic mein probability hoti hai jise threshold (aam taur par 0.5) se category mein badla jata hai.
24Data Cleaning mein sabse important steps kya hain?
Data cleaning mein 80% waqt lagta hai — CRISP-DM ke pehle 3 steps mein. Steps: de-duplication (duplicate hatana), outliers handle karna, consistency (ek cheez ke alag formats ko ek karna), validation rules (jaise age > 120 ho to flag), binning (groups banana), staleness (purana data hatana), merging (sources jodna), one-hot encoding (categories ko 0/1 columns mein badalna). Interview mein mortgage crisis ka example do — models ne falling house prices miss kar di, $700B bailout hua. 'Garbage in, garbage out' zaroor kaho.
25Structured, Unstructured aur Semi-structured data mein kya farak hai?
Structured data table mein fit hota hai — rows aur columns, jaise CRM/ERP data — lagbhag 20% AI project ka. Unstructured data table mein fit nahi hota — images, video, audio, text, social media — sabse zyada hissa, NoSQL chahiye. Semi-structured beech ka hai — XML, JSON (APIs se) — 5–10%. Time-series data alag category hai — waqt ke saath badlne wala, jaise sensor readings. Interview mein batao: data lake unstructured bhi handle karta hai, data warehouse sirf structured.
26RPA kya hai aur yeh AI se kaise alag hai?
RPA (Robotic Process Automation) software bots hain jo repetitive, rule-based kaam karte hain — invoices, data entry, refunds. Yeh 'robotic' physical robot nahi hai. AI se farak: RPA rules follow karta hai, seekhta nahi; AI data se seekhta hai. Jab RPA mein ML/NLP mil jaye to use Cognitive RPA (CRPA) kehte hain. Unattended RPA background mein khud chalta hai, RDA employee ke saath kaam karta hai. Interview mein Microsoft royalties case batao — 150 statements 2.5 ghante mein (pehle 50 ghante), 2,000% savings.
27AI project mein ROI kaise measure karte ho? KPIs kya honge?
ROI measure karne ke liye pehle clear KPIs tay karo — jaise chatbot ke liye resolution rate aur customer satisfaction, sales AI ke liye win rate (+10% Chorus case), maintenance ke liye cost saving (66% drone inspection case). Chapter 8 wale 4 rules yaad rakho: Quick Win (6–12 mahine), Meaningful (notable impact), Industry-Specific, Data quality. Interview mein batao: pehle baseline measure karo, phir pilot chalao, phir compare karo — aur automation fatigue ko dhyaan mein rakho (aasan kaam pehle automate hote hain, returns baad mein kam hote hain).
28AI mein Bias kaise aata hai aur isse kaise roka jata hai?
Bias training data se aata hai — jaise Amazon ka recruiting tool males ki taraf biased tha kyunki zyadatar resumes males se aaye the. Bias features se bhi aata hai — jaise face recognition mein ek hi type ke chehre zyada hon. Rokne ke tareeke: diverse aur representative data, bias audit karna, fairness metrics check karna, ethics board banana, aur human-in-the-loop rakhna. Interview mein batao: bias sirf technical problem nahi hai — legal liability bhi hai (discrimination claims), aur isiliye Algorithmic Accountability Act jaise laws aa rahe hain.
29TensorFlow vs PyTorch — kaun kab use karein?
TensorFlow (Google, 2011) production aur deployment mein strong hai — 41M+ downloads, TensorFlow Lite 2B+ mobile devices par, TensorFlow Serving se production deploy karna aasan. PyTorch (Facebook, 2016) research mein popular hai — dynamic computation graphs se runtime mein model change kar sakte ho, interface intuitive hai. Keras beginners ke liye hai — TensorFlow ne ise integrate kar liya. Interview mein batao: research/prototyping ke liye PyTorch, production/scale ke liye TensorFlow — lekin aaj dono mein gap kam ho gaya hai.
30AutoML kya hai aur kab use karna chahiye, kab nahi?
AutoML (Automated Machine Learning) data prep, feature selection aur model selection automate karta hai — citizen data scientists (bina strong technical background) bhi models bana sakte hain. Lenovo Brazil ka case: model creation 4 weeks se 3 days, production models 2 days se 5 minutes, accuracy <80% se 87.5%. Lekin caveat: bina expertise ke autoML se faulty assumptions wale models ban sakte hain — results AI na use karne se bhi bure ho sakte hain. Interview mein batao: autoML tab use karo jab experts ke saath ho — DataRobot pehle saal dedicated engineer deta hai.
31SLAM kya hai aur robots ke liye kyun mushkil hai?
SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) ka matlab hai — unknown environment ka map banana aur usi waqt apni location track karna. Robots ke liye mushkil hai kyunki environment noisy aur distracting hota hai, real-time mein kaam karna padta hai, aur sensors se data continuously aata hai. Isiliye robot AI mein progress slow hai — research zyada software models par focus karti hai. Interview mein Moravec paradox jodo: jo insaan ke liye aasan hai (chalna, dekhna), woh robot ke liye mushkil hai.
32Three Laws of Robotics kya hain aur kya woh kaafi hain?
Asimov ke Three Laws (1942): 1) Robot insaan ko nuksaan nahi pahunchayega, 2) Robot insaanon ke orders manega (jab tak Law 1 se conflict na ho), 3) Robot apni existence protect karega (jab tak Law 1–2 se conflict na ho). Baad mein Zeroth Law joda gaya: robot humanity ko nuksaan nahi pahunchayega. Yeh laws ethical framework ki shuruaat hain, lekin kaafi nahi hain — real situations complex hain (jaise autonomous car ka dilemma: kis se takraye?). Interview mein batao: aaj ke AI ethics boards aur regulations (Algorithmic Accountability Act) isi direction mein kadam hain.
33AGI kya hai aur kya yeh 2045 tak aa jayegi?
AGI (Artificial General Intelligence) woh AI hai jo insaan ki tarah har kaam kar sake — common sense, abstraction, curiosity, causal relationships samajhna. Aaj hum Weak AI phase mein hain. Ek futurist ne kaha AGI 2019 mein Turing Test crack karegi aur 2045 mein Singularity aayegi — hybrid humans (part human, part machine). Lekin zyada researchers ko lagta hai AGI bahut door hai — unsupervised learning, transfer learning, naye hardware aur energy sources mein breakthroughs chahiye. Interview mein balanced jawab do: timelines uncertain hain, lekin direction clear hai — models zyada general hote ja rahe hain.
34AI se jobs jayengi ya nayi jobs banengi?
Dono honge. AI repetitive kaam automate karegi — jaise ek robot 30 logon ka strawberry picking ka kaam karega, aur legal research automate ho rahi hai. Lekin naye careers bhi banenge — data scientists, AI trainers, prompt engineers, robot technicians. History mein manufacturing mein jobs gayi, lekin workforce adapt kar gaya. Pew ke hisaab se 40 saalon mein real wage growth lagbhag zero rahi — isliye reskilling aur education zaroori hai. Solutions: transition assistance, basic income, AI tax. Interview mein batao: AI jobs ko replace nahi, augment bhi karti hai — jaise doctors ko diagnosis mein madad.
35Autonomous cars ke 5 levels kya hain? Level 5 kab aayega?
Level 0: human sab control karta hai. Level 1: ek function computer control karta hai (cruise control). Level 2: do functions automate. Level 3: saare safety functions automate, driver intervene kar sakta hai. Level 4: car aam taur par khud chalti hai, kuch cases mein human chahiye. Level 5: Holy Grail — poori tarah autonomous, steering wheel ki zaroorat nahi. Level 5 kab aayega — estimates alag hain; ek CEO ne kaha steering wheel ke bina car mein abhi saal lagenge, aur poori fleet badalne mein 20 saal lag sakte hain. Challenges: infrastructure, regulation, costs (Lidar mehenga hai), aur public trust — AAA survey mein 71% log darte hain.
36Deep Learning ki sabse badi limitations kya hain?
2018 ke paper 'Deep Learning: A Critical Appraisal' mein 10 concerns diye: Black Box (faisla kyun liya, pata nahi chalta), Data hunger (ek example se nahi seekhta — bachcha 'taco' ek baar dekh kar seekh leta hai), No hierarchy (asli hierarchy nahi samajhta), Open-ended inference nahi (novel ke motivations nahi samajhta), No conceptual thinking (democracy, justice nahi samajhta), No common sense, Sirf correlation (causation nahi), No transfer learning (ek game seekh kar doosra nahi khel sakta), Static world mein best, aur bahut zyada resources (GPU cost). Interview mein batao: isiliye researchers DL se aage — neurosymbolic AI aur causal AI — ki taraf dekh rahe hain.
